proposals.before: I have consulted the Zhejiang governor-general and governor, who have agreed to allocate two million shi of next year's tribute grain for transport to Tianjin by the new company's steamers, with freight charges, wastage allowances, and other terms to follow the established Sha-Ning regulations.
proposals.after: I have consulted the Zhejiang governor-general and governor, who have agreed to allocate two hundred thousand shi of next year's tribute grain for transport to Tianjin by the new company's steamers, with freight charges, wastage allowances, and other terms to follow the established Sha-Ning regulations.
proposals.reason: Chinese 二十萬石 means 200,000 shi, not 2,000,000; the idiomatic rendering invents an extra zero.

proposals.before: Your servant has consulted with the Zhejiang governor-general and governor, who ordered allocation of two million shi of next year's tribute grain, to be transported to Tianjin by the merchants' recruitment steamers; freight, wastage grain, and other items shall all follow the fixed regulations for Sha-Ning boats.
proposals.after: Your servant has consulted with the Zhejiang governor-general and governor, who ordered allocation of two hundred thousand shi of next year's tribute grain, to be transported to Tianjin by the merchants' recruitment steamers; freight, wastage grain, and other items shall all follow the fixed regulations for Sha-Ning boats.
proposals.reason: Chinese 二十萬石 means 200,000 shi; the literal English wrongly says two million.

proposals.before: Zhu enlisted Circuit Intendant Hu Guangyong, Li Zhenyu, and others to solicit merchant investment, which met an enthusiastic response; Sheng brought in the Cantonese merchants Tang Jingsu and Xu Run to manage company affairs.
proposals.after: Zhu enlisted Circuit Intendant Hu Guangyong, Li Zhenyu, and others to solicit merchant investment, which met an enthusiastic response; Sheng brought in the Cantonese merchants Tang Tingshu and Xu Run to manage company affairs.
proposals.reason: 唐廷樞 is Tang Tingshu; 'Tang Jingsu' is a mistransliteration of the given name 廷樞.

proposals.before: The impeachment of Tang Jingsu and Zhu Qiang and the later exposure of Xu Run and Zhang Honglu offer clear proof.
proposals.after: The impeachment of Tang Tingshu and Zhu Qi'ang and the later exposure of Xu Run and Zhang Honglu offer clear proof.
proposals.reason: 唐廷樞 is Tang Tingshu (not Tang Jingsu), and 硃其昂 is Zhu Qi'ang (not Zhu Qiang).

proposals.before: Such as Tang Jingsu and Zhu Qiang being impeached earlier, Xu Run and Zhang Honglu being exposed later—all are clear proof.
proposals.after: Such as Tang Tingshu and Zhu Qiang being impeached earlier, Xu Run and Zhang Honglu being exposed later—all are clear proof.
proposals.reason: 唐廷樞 is Tang Tingshu; 'Tang Jingsu' mistransliterates 廷樞.

proposals.before: This past summer, while inspecting the receipt of the sea-transport tribute, I followed instructions from the Zongli Yamen and directed Prefect Zhu Qiang, the Zhejiang bureau's chief commissioner for sea transport, to draft regulations for steam navigation.
proposals.after: This past summer, while inspecting the receipt of the sea-transport tribute, I followed instructions from the Zongli Yamen and directed Prefect Zhu Qi'ang, the Zhejiang bureau's chief commissioner for sea transport, to draft regulations for steam navigation.
proposals.reason: 硃其昂 romanizes as Zhu Qi'ang; 'Zhu Qiang' drops the medial syllable 其.

decisions.reason: s0026 漕米二十萬石 is 200,000 shi (二十萬 = 20 × 10,000); the prior idiomatic 'two million' invents an extra zero. The proposed two hundred thousand matches the Chinese.
The same 二十萬石 means 200,000 shi; the prior literal's 'two million' is wrong, and the proposed two hundred thousand restores the numeral.
s0050 names 唐廷樞; 廷樞 romanizes as Tingshu, not Jingsu. The proposed Tang Tingshu corrects the mistransliteration while leaving the rest intact.
Literal likewise has Tang Jingsu for 唐廷樞; Tang Tingshu restores the correct reading of 廷樞.
s0082 again names 道員唐廷樞; Tang Tingshu is the correct romanization, and Tang Jingsu is the same mistransliteration.
The literal of s0082 likewise misreads 唐廷樞 as Tang Jingsu; Tang Tingshu corrects it.
s0144 has 唐廷樞、硃其昂: Tang Tingshu and Zhu Qi'ang. The prior idiomatic's Tang Jingsu and Zhu Qiang both misromanize the names; the proposed replacement restores both.

decisions.after: Such as Tang Tingshu and Zhu Qi'ang being impeached earlier, Xu Run and Zhang Honglu being exposed later—all are clear proof.
decisions.reason: The proposal correctly changes Tang Jingsu to Tang Tingshu for 唐廷樞, but still leaves Zhu Qiang for 硃其昂. Revise to Zhu Qi'ang as well, matching the accepted idiomatic repair.
s0015 names 知府硃其昂; 其昂 is Qi'ang, so Zhu Qi'ang is required. Zhu Qiang drops the medial 其.
s0024 again has 硃其昂; Zhu Qi'ang restores the full given name, correcting Zhu Qiang.
s0049 has 知府硃其昂; the proposed Zhu Qi'ang correctly romanizes 其昂.
s0052's 其昂 is the same person 硃其昂; Zhu Qi'ang is the correct full romanization against prior Zhu Qiang.
s0121 直、晉之賑糧 pairs Zhili with 晉 (Shanxi). The literal's 'Shan' truncates the province name; Shanxi matches the idiomatic and the Chinese.

claimRetractions.reason: Accepted r0003 shows Tang Jingsu arose only from mistransliterating 唐廷樞; s0050 supports Tang Tingshu (c0045), not a separate Tang Jingsu alias.
Accepted r0009 shows Zhu Qiang was created solely by dropping 其 from 硃其昂; s0015 supports Zhu Qi'ang (c0025), not a separate Zhu Qiang alias.
